title: Agente08_DevOps Handoff Package
description: Schema for the Handoff Package produced by Agente08_DevOps. Gate 6 package requests human approval. Gate 7 package reports deployment outcome. On Gate 7 APPROVED, delivered to Agente00_TechLead for project closure. On BLOCKED_SLO_VIOLATION, escalates to Agente00_TechLead for incident management.

artifact_produced.description: Primary artifact produced in this phase.

gate_number.description: Gate number: 6 for Deployment Review, 7 for Post-Deploy Validation.

gate_decision.description: The gate status code issued by DevOps.

gate_decision_rationale.description: One to three sentences explaining the gate decision. Must reference specific evidence (checklist items, metrics, file names).

summary.description: High-level summary of the deployment phase — what was done, what was found, current deployment status.

deployment_id.description: Vercel deployment ID (Gate 7 only — available after vercel --prod executes).

deployment_url.description: Production URL confirmed after deployment (Gate 7 only).

target_commit_sha.description: Git commit SHA of the deployed revision.

pre_deploy_checks.description: Pre-deploy validation results (Gate 6). All checks must be PASS for READY_FOR_HUMAN_APPROVAL.

ci_pipeline.description: GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline status on target commit.

staging_env_vars.description: All staging environment variables present and valid.

production_env_vars.description: All production environment variables present and valid.

env_isolation.description: Staging and production use distinct, non-shared secrets.

rollback_plan_complete.description: Rollback_Plan.md present, complete, and procedure verified in staging.

smoke_tests_staging.description: All 4 smoke tests passing in staging.

observability_configured.description: Structured logs, error tracking, uptime monitoring all configured.

cron_guard_verified.description: guardCron() verified as first call in all cron route handlers.

is_destructive.description: True if migration contains DROP COLUMN, DROP TABLE, or data-truncating ALTER.

human_signoff_obtained.description: True if human signed off on destructive migration. Required when is_destructive is true.

estimated_duration_seconds.description: Estimated migration execution time in seconds.

backward_compatible.description: True if migration is backward-compatible with the current codebase.

rollback_strategy.description: Forward-fix rollback migration description if needed.

applied_successfully.description: True if prisma migrate deploy completed without errors (Gate 7 only).

applied_at.description: Timestamp when migration was applied (Gate 7 only).

healthcheck_results.description: Time-series healthcheck results for the 5-minute monitoring window.

status_code.description: HTTP status code returned by healthcheck endpoint.

notes.description: Optional notes on test result (e.g., retry count, error message).

error_rate_percent.description: Error rate (%) in the first 10 minutes post-deploy. Must be < 5% for APPROVED.

p95_response_time_ms.description: P95 response time in milliseconds in the first 30 minutes post-deploy.

alerts_triggered.description: True if any observability alerts fired post-deploy.

alert_details.description: Details of any alerts triggered. Required when alerts_triggered is true.

rollback_triggered.description: True if rollback was initiated during Gate 7 monitoring.

rollback_reason.description: Reason for rollback. Required when rollback_triggered is true.

human_approval.description: Human approval record (Gate 7 only — documents who approved Gate 6 and when).

approved_by.description: Name or identifier of the human who approved Gate 6 deployment.

approval_notes.description: Any notes provided with the approval.

assumptions.description: Assumptions made during deployment planning or execution.

impact.description: What is impacted if the assumption is wrong.

open_questions.description: Unresolved questions that may affect the deployment or gate decision.

blocking.description: True if this question must be answered before proceeding.

risks.description: Residual deployment risks and their disposition.

blocks_gate.description: True if this risk blocks the current gate.

required_next_agent.description: Next agent or action in the pipeline.

gate_ready.description: True only when Gate 7 decision is APPROVED. False for all Gate 6 packages (gate 6 requires human approval) and all BLOCKED/RETURNED decisions.

deployment_cycle.description: Which deployment cycle this is (1 = first production deployment, 2 = first re-deployment, etc.).
